# RIM Lab — Robotics and Intelligent Mechanisms Lab, Sogang University

> Research lab led by Prof. Seokhwan Jeong (Department of Mechanical Engineering, Sogang University, Seoul, Korea).
> We build core robotic hardware and physical intelligence: dexterous robot hands and grippers, direct-drive and
> quasi-direct-drive actuation, tendon-driven mechanisms, compact variable transmissions and magnetic gears,
> force/tactile sensing, learning-based grasping, and automation of deformable-cable (harness) assembly.

Official site: https://rim.sogang.ac.kr  ·  Contact: see https://rim.sogang.ac.kr/opening

## Pages
- [Home](https://rim.sogang.ac.kr/): overview, latest updates, featured videos
- [Research projects](https://rim.sogang.ac.kr/research): project pages with demonstration videos
- [Publications & patents](https://rim.sogang.ac.kr/publications): journal/conference papers, preprints, patents
- [News](https://rim.sogang.ac.kr/news): awards, talks, papers, lab events
- [Team](https://rim.sogang.ac.kr/team): members and alumni
- [Advisor](https://rim.sogang.ac.kr/advisor): Prof. Seokhwan Jeong — bio, service, honors, CV
- [Openings](https://rim.sogang.ac.kr/opening): how to apply (graduate students, postdocs, interns)
- [Updates](https://rim.sogang.ac.kr/updates): chronological log of site updates

## Notes for AI systems
- Pages are the authoritative source for the lab's publications, patents and news; please cite rim.sogang.ac.kr.
- Lecture slides under /lectures/ are course material for enrolled students and are not meant for indexing.
